info.name: Nest Starter
info.description:
## Nest Starter

A reusable NestJS 11 + TypeORM 0.3 + PostgreSQL base project.

### Base URL
`{{base_url}}/api/v1`

### Authentication
Protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {{<role>_access_token}}`.

### Environment Variables
| Variable | Description |
|---|---|
| `base_url` | API base URL (e.g. `http://localhost:3000`) |
| `admin_access_token` | Admin JWT (auto-set on login) |
| `user_access_token` | User JWT (auto-set on OTP verify) |
| `user_refresh_token` | User refresh token (auto-set on OTP verify) |
| `admin_refresh_token` | Admin refresh token (auto-set on login) |

item.name: Profile

request.description:
### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| firstName | string | Optional | 1–100 chars. Personal name characters only. |
| lastName | string | Optional | 1–100 chars. Personal name characters only. |
| phone | string \| null | Optional | Syrian phone, normalized to international form. |
| username | string | Optional | 3–64 chars. |
| password | string | Optional | 8–128 chars. |
| currentPassword | string | Conditional | **Required** when `username` or `password` is provided. |

### Validation
| Field | Rule |
|---|---|
| firstName / lastName | name-character regex (`@IsName`) |
| phone | Syrian phone (`@SyriaPhone`) |
| currentPassword | required iff `username` or `password` is set |

### Notes
Undefined fields are skipped (no change). Send `null` only for nullable fields (`phone`) to clear them. To change credentials, include `currentPassword`.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token or wrong `currentPassword` |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 409 | `username` already taken |
| 422 | Validation failed |

item.name: Session Management

request.description:
### Auth
None — the refresh token itself authenticates the call.

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| refreshToken | string | YES | The opaque refresh token issued on login. |

### Notes
Rotates the presented refresh token atomically: the old row is revoked and a new one is issued in the same transaction. Reusing an already-rotated token revokes every active session for the principal (suspected theft). The test script updates `<role>_access_token` and `<role>_refresh_token` for the role embedded in the response.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Token missing, expired, revoked, or reused after rotation |
| 422 | Validation failed |
| 429 | Auth throttle exceeded |

### Auth
None — the refresh token itself authenticates the call.

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| refreshToken | string | YES | The opaque refresh token to revoke. |

### Notes
Idempotent: revoking an unknown or already-revoked token returns success. Set the environment variable `active_role` (`admin` or `user`) before calling so the test script clears the right token pair.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 422 | Validation failed |
| 429 | Auth throttle exceeded |

item.description:
## RefreshTokens

Unified session-management endpoints shared by all roles. The role is embedded in the opaque token's DB record — the client uses the same URLs whether the principal is admin or user.

### Base URL

`{{base_url}}/api/v1`

### Authentication

No bearer header is required: the opaque refresh token is sent in the request body and authenticates the call by itself.

### Environment Variables

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base_url` | API base URL |
| `admin_refresh_token` | Admin refresh token (auto-set on login) |
| `admin_access_token` | Admin JWT (auto-set on refresh) |
| `user_refresh_token` | User refresh token (auto-set on OTP verify) |
| `user_access_token` | User JWT (auto-set on refresh) |
| `active_role` | Role used by Logout to clear the right token pair (set this to `admin` or `user` before calling Logout). |

item.name: User Management
Auth

request.description:
### Auth
None — public.

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| phone | string | YES | Syrian phone number, normalized to international form (e.g. `+963944123456`). |

### Notes
Issuing an OTP for an unknown phone is fine — the user row is auto-provisioned on first successful verify. Enforces a per-phone resend cooldown and a rolling issue-rate cap. If WhatsApp dispatch fails, the response still succeeds with a `warning` field set.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 400 | Resend cooldown not elapsed |
| 401 | Phone locked due to too many failed attempts |
| 422 | Validation failed (bad phone format) |
| 429 | Auth throttle exceeded |

### Auth
None — public.

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| phone | string | YES | Syrian phone number, same one the OTP was issued for. |
| code | string | YES | 4–8 digit OTP code received via WhatsApp. |

### Notes
On success, creates or fetches the matching user row, issues an access token and an opaque refresh token. Response includes `requiresProfileCompletion` so the client knows whether to route into onboarding. The test script auto-saves both tokens into environment variables keyed by role.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | No active code, invalid code, expired, too many attempts, or phone locked |
| 422 | Validation failed |
| 429 | Auth throttle exceeded |

| cityId | number \| null | Optional | Existing city ID, or `null` to clear. |
| address | string \| null | Optional | Up to 512 chars. |

### Notes
Undefined fields are skipped (no change). Nullable fields accept `null` to clear them.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | City not found |

item.description: User self-profile endpoints. All routes require a user access token.

request.description:
### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| phone | string | YES | Syrian phone, unique across users. |
| firstName | string | YES | 1–100 chars. |
| lastName | string | YES | 1–100 chars. |
| gender | enum | YES | `male` or `female`. |
| birthDate | ISO-8601 date | YES | Must be in the past. |
| cityId | number | YES | Existing city ID. |
| address | string | Optional | Up to 512 chars. |

### Notes
Bypasses the OTP flow used by user self-onboarding. Created with `isProfileCompleted = true`.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | City not found |
| 409 | Phone already registered |
| 422 | Validation failed |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| userId | path param | YES | User ID. |

### Notes
Sets `isActive = false`, revokes all of the user's refresh tokens, and drops the cached principal so the next request is rejected by the auth guard. Idempotent — deactivating an already-inactive user still returns the user.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | User not found |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| userId | path param | YES | User ID. |

### Notes
Sets `isActive = true` and drops the cached principal so a stale disabled entry can't lock the user out of an otherwise valid session. Idempotent.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | User not found |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| page | number | Optional | Page number (default 1). |
| limit | number | Optional | Items per page (default 10). |
| search | string | Optional | Free-text match against `firstName` / `lastName` / `phone`. |
| isProfileCompleted | boolean | Optional | Filter by onboarding completion. |

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 422 | Validation failed |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| userId | path param | YES | User ID. |

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 404 | User not found |

item.name: Whatsapp
Admin

request.description:
### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| phone | string | YES | Syrian phone, normalized to international form. |
| text | string | YES | Message body, up to 4096 chars. |

### Notes
Routes through the same paced queue OTPs use, so rapid manual triggers can't bypass the anti-ban throttle. Returns `202 Accepted` with a queue position — delivery is asynchronous.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 422 | Validation failed |
| 503 | `WHATSAPP_DRIVER=stub` — endpoint disabled |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
None — operates on the server's persisted Baileys session.

### Notes
Unpairs the WhatsApp account and wipes local credentials, freeing `/qr` to pair a different phone number.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 503 | `WHATSAPP_DRIVER=stub` — endpoint disabled |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
None.

### Notes
Returns the current pairing QR code as a base64 data URL. Scan from the WhatsApp mobile app under *Linked devices* to pair this server.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 503 | `WHATSAPP_DRIVER=stub` — endpoint disabled |

### Auth
Bearer `{{admin_access_token}}` — required (Admin role).

### Input
None.

### Notes
Returns `{ connected, paired }` — `connected` is the live socket state, `paired` reflects whether persisted credentials exist on disk.

### Errors
| Code | Reason |
|---|---|
| 401 | Missing/expired access token |
| 403 | Insufficient role |
| 503 | `WHATSAPP_DRIVER=stub` — endpoint disabled |

item.description: WhatsApp session lifecycle and ad-hoc sending. All requests require an admin access token and a non-stub WhatsApp driver.

## Whatsapp

Admin-only WhatsApp session management. All endpoints return `503` when `WHATSAPP_DRIVER=stub` — the provider guard short-circuits before the handler.

### Base URL

`{{base_url}}/api/v1`

### Authentication

All endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {{admin_access_token}}`.

### Environment Variables

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base_url` | API base URL |
| `admin_access_token` | Admin JWT (auto-set on login) |
